name: Italian Tofu Scramble with Potatoes, Zucchini & Cherry Tomatoes
instructions: Cut the tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich the tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Small dice the potatoes (cut into ¼-inch cubes). Transfer to a medium saucepan and cover with hot water (from the tap). Bring to a boil over high heat; reduce heat and simmer, covered, for 9 minutes. Once finished, drain the potatoes and set aside.
Peel and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic.
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and garlic, and cook, stirring occasionally, 3-4 minutes.
Halve zucchinis lengthwise, then slice crosswise into half rounds. Add the zucchinis and spices to the skillet and stir to combine.
Crumble the tofu with your fingers into the skillet. Add the cooked potatoes and stir to combine. Sauté until the veggies are softened, 7-8 minutes.
Remove from the heat and stir in the grape tomatoes. Divide between plates and enjoy!
author: Mealime
